pokedexEntries.rb: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon’s. It leaves a tingling sensation when it licks enemies.

pokedexEntries.ye: Its tongue spans almost 7 feet and moves more freely than its forelegs. Its licks can cause paralysis.

pokedexEntries.go: Its tongue has well-developed nerves that run to the very tip, so it can be deftly manipulated.

pokedexEntries.si: Its long tongue, slathered with a gooey saliva, sticks to anything, so it is very useful.

pokedexEntries.cr: It has a tongue that is over 6’6’’ long. It uses this long tongue to lick its body clean.

pokedexEntries.rs: Whenever LICKITUNG comes across something new, it will unfailingly give it a lick. It does so because it memorizes things by texture and by taste. It is somewhat put off by sour things.

pokedexEntries.fr: Its tongue is twice the length of its body. It can be moved like an arm for grabbing food and attacking.

pokedexEntries.lg: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon’s. It leaves a tingling sensation when it licks enemies.

pokedexEntries.em: Whenever it sees something unfamiliar, it always licks the object because it memorizes things by texture and taste. It is somewhat put off by sour things.

pokedexEntries.dp: Instead of hands, it uses its tongue, which is twice its height. Its sticky saliva grips anything.

pokedexEntries.pt: When it extends its over-six-foot-long tongue, its tail quivers. There is a possibility they are connected.

pokedexEntries.hg: Its tongue has well-developed nerves that run to the very tip, so it can be deftly manipulated.

pokedexEntries.ss: Its long tongue, slathered with a gooey saliva, sticks to anything, so it is very useful.

pokedexEntries.bw: When it extends its over-six-foot-long tongue, its tail quivers. There is a possibility they are connected.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Being licked by its long, saliva-covered tongue leaves a tingling sensation. Extending its tongue retracts its tail.

pokedexEntries.x: Its long tongue, slathered with a gooey saliva, sticks to anything, so it is very useful.

pokedexEntries.y: Its tongue is twice the length of its body. It can be moved like an arm for grabbing food and attacking.

pokedexEntries.oras: Whenever Lickitung comes across something new, it will unfailingly give it a lick. It does so because it memorizes things by texture and by taste. It is somewhat put off by sour things.

pokedexEntries.us: It checks out whatever’s around it by licking everything. If you don’t clean off a spot where it’s licked you, you’ll break out in a rash!

pokedexEntries.um: It licks filth clean with its tongue. Whatever it licks always stinks afterward, so whether it’s really clean is...questionable.

pokedexEntries.lgpe: Its tongue spans almost seven feet and moves more freely than its forelegs. Its licks can cause paralysis.

pokedexEntries.sw: If this Pokémon’s sticky saliva gets on you and you don’t clean it off, an intense itch will set in. The itch won’t go away, either.

pokedexEntries.sh: Bug Pokémon are Lickitung’s main food source. This Pokémon paralyzes its prey with a lick from its long tongue, then swallows the prey whole.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: Instead of its hands, it uses its tongue, which can stretch to twice this Pokémon’s height. Lickitung’s sticky saliva grips anything.

pokedexEntries.la: Wields its long tongue deftly, as though it were an arm. The Pokémon’s viscous saliva, once it has been collected and boiled down, yields a strong and highly useful adhesive.
